items.definition:
a long wall or embankment built to prevent flooding from the sea or a river
The engineers worked to strengthen the dike before the storm hit.

the part of a roof that meets or overhangs the walls of a building
Birds often build nests under the eaves of the house.

a person who does small repairs or odd jobs
We hired a handyman to fix the leaky faucet.

A person who leaves a place or organization
The school leaver was excited about starting university.

A sweet, chewy black confectionery
She doesn't like the taste of black licorice.

The exact middle point
We met at the midpoint of the journey.

a tiered tower with multiple eaves, built in East and Southeast Asia
We visited an ancient pagoda during our trip to Japan.

a large, heavily built plant-eating mammal with one or two horns on the nose
We saw a rhinoceros at the zoo.

a light two-wheeled passenger vehicle drawn by one or more people
We took a rickshaw ride through the old city.

fine particles of wood produced during sawing
The floor of the workshop was covered in sawdust.

the son of one's husband or wife by a previous marriage
Her stepson is visiting for the holidays.

a drinking glass without a stem or handle; a part of a lock
He poured water into a tall tumbler.

An undergraduate student.
My sister is an undergrad studying history.

An area where work is done.
My workspace is usually very tidy.

an animal that feeds on flesh
Lions are powerful carnivores that hunt in prides.

device that decodes
You need a special decoder to watch encrypted channels.

green foliage, plants, or vegetation
The garden was full of lush greenery.

a six-sided polygon
A beehive is made of many hexagonal cells.

the dry outer covering of some fruits or seeds
You need to remove the husk from the corn before cooking it.

difficulty in digesting food
Eating too much spicy food can cause indigestion.

A traditional Korean side dish of fermented vegetables.
Kimchi is a staple of Korean cuisine.

a woman's one-piece garment combining stockings and tights
She wore pantyhose under her dress for the formal event.

a small, plain cake, typically eaten with butter, jam, and cream
We had tea and scones with clotted cream.

a window set in a roof or ceiling
The attic room had a large skylight, letting in plenty of natural light.

one of the rods connecting the center of a wheel to its rim
One of the spokes on my bicycle wheel is bent.

a cylindrical device on which film, thread, etc., is wound
She wound the thread onto a small wooden spool.

a Korean martial art, characterized by punching and kicking techniques
She practices taekwondo twice a week.

a large, low-pitched brass wind instrument
The tuba provides the deep bass notes in the orchestra.

the cost of a plane ticket
The airfare to London was surprisingly cheap.

lack of attention or thought about what you are doing
His carelessness led to several mistakes in the report.

a heavy fall of rain
We got caught in a sudden downpour.

the eastern part of a town or area
They live on the eastside of the city.

a young horse or other equine animal
The mare gave birth to a healthy foal.

a type of edible marine fish
Fish and chips often uses cod or haddock.

a hole in a lock into which a key is inserted
She peered through the keyhole to see if anyone was inside.

a person who avoids work; a type of slip-on shoe
He was often called a loafer because he never seemed to do any work.

a facial expression indicating displeasure
She gave a little pout when she didn't get her way.

a summary of a person's education, qualifications, and employment history
She submitted her résumé to apply for the job.

a grassland ecosystem characterized by scattered trees
Lions roam freely across the African savanna.

science fiction
He loves reading classic scifi novels.

a form of precipitation consisting of ice pellets
The forecast predicts sleet and freezing rain tonight.

a long, high-pitched cry or sound
We heard a loud squeal of tires as the car braked suddenly.

A long, narrow loaf of French bread.
She bought a fresh baguette from the bakery.

The quality or state of being cool (temperature or demeanor).
The coolness of the evening air was refreshing.

a thing that drops or has dropped; animal excrement
We found bird droppings on the car windshield.

A fleshy, typically large fruit with a hard skin, some varieties of which are edible.
The farmer grew several types of gourds in his garden.

A carnivorous mammal of Africa and Asia, with a doglike appearance and a distinctive 'laughing' cry.
The hyena's distinctive laugh echoed across the savanna.

A performance in a theater or cinema during the daytime
We decided to go to the matinee showing of the new movie.

a person from Nicaragua
The Nicaraguan ambassador spoke at the conference.

a young pig
The sow had a litter of ten tiny piglets.

a friend with whom a child plays
My daughter invited her playmate over for the afternoon.

a flavored ice confection on a stick
On a hot day, nothing beats a cold popsicle.

a type of dog with long drooping ears and a silky coat
My neighbor has a cute cocker spaniel.

casual trousers made of soft, absorbent fabric
I like to wear sweatpants when I'm relaxing at home.

a bird that pecks holes in trees
A woodpecker was tapping loudly on the tree trunk.

a line or course having abrupt alternate right and left turns
The path followed a zigzag pattern up the hill.

a strip of ground for the takeoff and landing of aircraft
The small plane landed on the remote airstrip.

a small animal or creature (often used affectionately or humorously)
Look at that little beastie crawling on the leaf.

a refund or percentage of money returned on a purchase
I got cashback when I paid with my debit card.

the process of selecting actors for a play or film; an object made by pouring molten metal into a mold
The casting for the new movie took several months.

a type of small dog, especially a cocker spaniel
My neighbor has a friendly cocker spaniel.

a thick, quilted blanket used as a bed covering; a person or thing that provides comfort
She pulled the warm comforter up to her chin.

a brass musical instrument resembling a trumpet; a type of ice cream cone
The musician played a solo on the cornet.

a public hall for dancing
They spent the evening dancing at the local dancehall.
